independence_evidence: ArtReview's own about page states 'ArtReview Ltd is part of Meta Media Group', the Hong Kong-listed media group (formerly Modern Media Holdings, HKEX stock code 72) whose titles include Modern Weekly, Nowness, LEAP and Numéro China; press reports confirm Modern Media acquired a majority stake in 2019.
qualifies_reason: Fails the independence test: ArtReview Ltd is majority-owned by Meta Media Holdings, a stock-exchange-listed media group with many titles.
what_it_is: ArtReview is a long-running international contemporary art magazine from London, publishing criticism, reviews, opinion columns, artist interviews and commissioned artist projects, with special annual issues such as Future Greats and the Power 100 ranking. It appears about seven to nine times a year (some issues cover two months) alongside the quarterly ArtReview Asia and a Chinese edition, and often ships with a themed supplement. It is read by curators, collectors, artists and art students as well as general readers of contemporary art.
